title: Magento : Search for products by SKU (wildcard) and list the stock
content:
<?php
$soap_url = 'http://magento.url/index.php/api/v2_soap?wsdl';

$client = new SoapClient($soap_url);
$session = $client->login('api_user', 'api_key');

$sku = 'msj006c';
$filter = [
    'complex_filter' => [
        [
            'key' => 'sku',
            'value' => ['key' => 'like', 'value' => "%{$sku}%"]
            ]
        ]
    ];


$products = $client->catalogProductList($session, $filter);
$skus = object_key_search('sku', $products);

$stocks = $client->catalogInventoryStockItemList($session, $skus);

var_dump($stocks);

// ---

function object_key_search($needle, $haystack)
{
    $needle_values = [];
    foreach ($haystack as $item) {
        if (array_key_exists($needle, $item)) {
            $needle_values[] = $item->$needle;
        }
    }

    return $needle_values;
}
